title: Odd-order graphs do not exhibit Laplacian perfect state transfer
statement: Let $X$ be a simple connected unweighted graph on an odd number of vertices. **Odd-order Laplacian PST conjecture.** Laplacian perfect state transfer does not occur in $X$. This extends the corresponding result for unweighted graphs on $3$ or $5$ vertices and follows for weighted join graphs under the additional assumption that the characteristic polynomial of the Laplacian has integer coefficients; the general case remains open.
source_name: Steve Kirkland and Hermie Monterde, “Quantum walks on join graphs”, arXiv:2312.06906 (2023).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.06906

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2023).
